dedupe_keys.name: a spatio temporal dataset for satellite based landslide detection

description: A Spatio-Temporal Dataset for Satellite-Based Landslide Detection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Paul Höhn et al. The capability to accurately detect and monitor landslides helps explain their dynamics and reduce associated risks. However, existing deep learning models often struggle to effectively capture temporal dynamics from satellite imagery, limiting their reliability in analyzing landslide behavior over time. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: NetCDF, Image. The data are held in Hugging Face and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
